text: 长源东谷公告，公司拟通过发行股份方式向湖北芯源动力科技集团有限公司购买襄阳康豪机电工程有限公司100%股权，交易作价50.1亿元，并向不超过35名特定投资者发行股份募集配套资金，金额不超过20亿元。本次交易构成关联交易和重大资产重组，不构成重组上市；发行价格为29.75元/股，拟发行1.68亿股，占发行后总股本34.19%。交易尚需股东会批准、上交所审核通过及中国证监会注册同意等。
text_en: Changyuan Donggu announced that it plans to purchase 100% equity of Xiangyang Kanghao Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Co., Ltd. from Hubei Xinyuan Power Technology Group Co., Ltd. by issuing shares, with a transaction value of 5.01 billion yuan, and plans to issue shares to no more than 35 specific investors to raise supporting funds of no more than 2 billion yuan. The transaction constitutes a related-party transaction and a major asset restructuring, but does not constitute a restructuring-based listing; the issue price is 29.75 yuan per share, with a planned issuance of 168 million shares, accounting for 34.19% of total post-issuance share capital. The transaction is still subject to approval by the shareholders' meeting, review by the Shanghai Stock Exchange, and registration approval by the CSRC, among others.
